column1: # outbound/patterns.tsv -- the outbound scan's pattern list (DND-699).
# One pattern per line: <label><TAB><regex>. Blank lines and # lines are skipped.
# The label matches [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63} and is NOT sensitive
# (slack-person-3, work-ticket-id); the regex IS, so this file never leaves
# this machine. The floor is the COMMITTED copy: commit every addition.
# This skeleton ships with NO patterns. With none, the scanner reports
# COULD NOT MEASURE, so scripts/setup-private-overlay does not install the
# pre-push hook until at least one pattern is committed here.
